name: Barbell Deficit Deadlift
steps: Stand on a flat weight plate with the barbell over your midfoot, then hinge and bend your knees to grip outside your shins.
Pull your chest slightly up, engage your lats to remove slack, and brace your core with a flat back.
Drive powerfully through your feet, extending your hips and knees smoothly to stand tall with the bar close to your legs.
Hinge back at your hips and bend your knees to return the bar gently to the floor.
tips: Choose a plate height that lets you reach the bar cleanly without rounding your lower back.
Stay patient off the floor and push evenly through your midfoot rather than letting your hips shoot up first.
